button: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI asset for the dark gothic fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Sculptural hand-painted aged materials, deep chiaroscuro, subtle grain, worn bronze with narrow gold edges over blackened iron, restrained thorn-like corner ornament matching medieval gothic modal windows. Orthographic perfectly front-facing UI element, symmetrical rectangular shape, no perspective. No text, no symbols, no letters, no icon, no watermark. Wide horizontal image about 3:1 aspect ratio. One element only, fully visible, outer metal edges aligned very close to image edges, no large empty margins. Design for CSS nine-slice scaling: all ornamental corners contained in outer 15 percent of width and outer 35 percent of height; central edge segments simple repeatable straight metal rails. Inside area calm and dark so small cream text added by HTML remains readable. Only gaps outside the outline are truly transparent alpha, the inside is opaque. Primary request: a raised clickable rectangular text button with dark bronze plate center, softly lit bevel, strong clean gold-bronze outer rim, small symmetric pointed ornaments at all four corners, modest wear. Broad uncluttered center has subtle warm charcoal grain. Button should feel tactile and raised, elegant not shiny or noisy. Keep central 70 percent free of ornament.
